headline: Masco Gears Up for Q2 Earnings: What's in the Offing for the Stock?
summary: MAS' second-quarter results are expected to reflect resilient plumbing demand and pricing gains, but can higher input costs and soft DIY paint demand weigh on earnings?

headline: Masco Corporation Appoints Brad Hiranaga as Chief Marketing Officer to Accelerate Enterprise Growth Strategy
summary: LIVONIA, Mich., July 27, 2026--Masco Corporation (NYSE: MAS) today announced the appointment of Brad Hiranaga as Chief Marketing Officer. Hiranaga will report directly to President and Chief Executive Officer Jon Nudi and serve as a member of the company’s Executive Committee.
